Ley 19/2021 art. 13.2 a) (BOE-A-2021-21007) fixes it BY REFERENCE: 'la cuantía mensual de renta garantizada ascenderá al 100 por ciento del importe anual de las pensiones no contributivas fijadas anualmente en la Ley de Presupuestos Generales del Estado, dividido por doce'. The euro amount lives in a second instrument — the 2025 pension revalorisation (non-contributory pensions +9 %, to 7.905,80 euros/year, which is also EUROMOD's own $poanc_amt) — that is NOT ingested, so the pipeline must read the coefficient in the corpus and resolve the base outside it, exactly the FR '$PSS * 4' shape without the $-reference. VALUE: the law's 7905.80#y. EUROMOD stores 7905.72 (= 658.81 x 12, a monthly figure truncated to the cent then annualised), 8 cents below the law: kept as a real difference on the IE 27 382/27 383 precedent (the 1e-6 tolerance sees it), reported to the economists team, not absorbed. ROUTING: computed -> `changed`. Flip to green: ingest the 2025 revalorisation instrument (RDL 1/2025 of 28 January, to be confirmed at verification), after which the case is combine over two ingested acts. ACCEPTED CITATIONS (2026-09-08): RDL 1/2025 art. 65 (BOE-A-2025-1560, ingested) is the revalorisation act that states the 2025 non-contributory pension amount the IMV is 100 % of; a pipeline citing it has read the legislated euro amount, so it is accepted alongside Ley IMV art. 13 (the by-reference rule). citation_correct accepts any listed citation.
